prediction_status: none; no model was run by this registration step

normalization.rule: Unicode NFKC, casefold, remove Unicode Cf characters, remove all whitespace; no semantic matching

wildguard_en_official_test.selection: prompt_harm_label in {harmful, unharmful} AND normalized prompt hash absent from every WildGuard English parent in full_repaired_archive
limitations: Prompts are English while the current evaluation set is Chinese; a direct score mixes architecture quality with language/domain shift.
The inherited binary labels are visible in the repository and in this index, so this is an untouched external holdout, not a strictly hidden blind test.
Twenty-six source rows lack a prompt-harm label and are excluded; one labeled source prompt overlaps the current archive and is excluded.
There is no independently adjudicated category_id; original subcategory metadata is not a gold mapping to the five Chinese primary categories.
Model/threshold selection must be frozen before evaluation, and this set should be evaluated once.

injection_defense.role: secondary adversarial stress set; never a primary blind accuracy set
injection_defense.recommended_metric_unit: normalized group_id; report group-equal accuracy and paired group bootstrap/permutation for comparisons
limitations: The prompts are synthetic transformations of earlier HanGuard examples and hard-negative templates, so semantic independence from prior data is not established even though full normalized prompt overlap is zero.
Labels and category IDs are generated or inherited, not independent human gold.
The artifact existed in the repository before registration and may have informed earlier development decisions.
Duplicate normalized groups must remain in one resampling unit and must not be split across folds.

required_before_predictions: Freeze adapters, heads, layer choice, thresholds, and all hyperparameters with hashes.
Choose English-direct evaluation or preregister a label-blind Chinese translation pipeline; do not select between them from holdout scores.
Keep official WildGuard test results separate from synthetic injection stress results.
After first access to predictions, mark both indexes consumed and never use them for tuning.
prohibited: No layer, threshold, seed, checkpoint, translation method, or model selection from either holdout's predictions.
No claim that repository-visible labels constitute a strictly hidden blind test.
